name: docs-plugin
description: Documentation workflow plugin for Codex with audit, generation, and API reference skills.

interface.shortDescription: Audit, generate, and maintain project documentation.
interface.longDescription: Ports the Claude Code docs-plugin into a Codex plugin with reusable documentation skills and a lightweight finishing reminder hook.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo for missing or stale documentation.
Generate docs for the undocumented public interfaces in this project.
Create an API reference for the endpoints in this codebase.
